source.title: Vendored skills: upstream updates available
source.body:
Weekly check found vendored skill sources that advanced past their pin
(past the 3-day cooldown) or upstream skills not yet vendored.

Re-vendoring is manual and reviewed (see AGENTS.md "Skills (portable via sync)").
After re-vendoring, bump the pin in SKILLS.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md,
scripts/update-skills.sh, and the re-vendored skills' upstream_commit frontmatter, then run
`scripts/update-skills.sh --check-pins`.

<details><summary>Full report</summary>

